item.title: Repeated Overflowing Bins and Litter on Beckenham Road, 4th October
item.description:
The bins on Beckenham Road are regularly overflowing, with litter spread across the area, particularly at weekends. This problem keeps happening. Reports are marked as fixed or resolved, but every weekend residents are having to contact the council again because the bins are overflowing and litter is left across Beckenham Road. This is an ongoing problem and needs a permanent solution.

item.title: Broken fence post in West Heath recreation park, 4th October
item.description:
The mesh fence posts in West Heath recreation park at the back of 60 Abbotts walk Da75rj are broken. The concrete and metal posts over the years have rotted and are broken and sharp. Lately Bedonwell Junior school have fun days in the park and the children love to come to the fence, call names and run away. No problem. But what is a problem is that the children can come into contact with the broken fence. An accident waiting to happen.
